unchanged_native_tests: All other tests in both caller files are unchanged; the baseline presentation filter also includes the existing standup row-budget test in standup.rs.

native_validation.python_unavailable: Compiled lib test executable run directly in bwrap --unshare-all --die-with-parent --new-session; only /usr/lib, loader-cache, proc/dev, exact disposable run and read-only repository mounted. /usr/bin and /bin are empty; PATH=/python-unavailable. Absolute /usr/bin/python3 -V execution probe failed with ENOENT before running both filters. This is interpreter filesystem isolation, not a claim of seccomp denial of every possible subprocess.
native_validation.storage: Unique disposable runs under verified btrfs /home/jdawson/.cache/agent-test-runs; TMPDIR and CARGO_TARGET_DIR scoped per run; exact-run exit traps clean capture and build artifacts on success/failure. No downloads, retained artifacts or full-suite execution.

limitations: Frozen comparison cases preserve only the seven existing native-test obligations. They do not establish new coverage of any of the 941 original Python methods.
The reference capture uses Python-native ledger creation and real ephemeral control locations; UUID/root/device/inode values are not output and are not embedded in fixture data.
Historical fixtures and provenance are neither changed nor recaptured. This oracle explicitly selects the approved active 24d73fe source.
Production Python removal, global audit integration, Cargo package inputs and independent review remain main-owned.
